description: Inspect a TouchDesigner TDAbleton mapper COMP and its source CHOP. Reports common mapper symptoms and can optionally repair Oscinputchop, Reorder, Bypass, and Min/Max parameters without requiring AbletonMCP or a live Ableton connection.

expected_reorder.description: Expected Reorder parameter value and required source channel list.

mapper_path.description: Optional explicit path to the TDAbleton TDA_Mapper COMP.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP/project used when auto-searching for a TDA_Mapper COMP.

repair.description: If true, apply best-effort mapper parameter repairs inside TouchDesigner.

source_chop.description: CHOP expected to drive the TDAbleton mapper.

name: diagnose_tdableton_mapper
title: Diagnose TDAbleton Mapper
